summary: Process Free Goods (Sample) order for healthcare provider
businessObject: Sales Order (Free Goods / Promotional Sample type)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can create a Sales Order with an order type designated for "Free Goods" or "Promotional Samples".
The system automatically sets the pricing condition to zero for all line items in the Free Goods order.
The system requires the user to specify a reason code for the free goods (e.g., "New Product Launch", "Physician Sample", "Patient Assistance").
The system validates that the customer is an approved healthcare provider eligible to receive promotional samples.
The system tracks the cumulative quantity of free goods shipped to each healthcare provider for compliance reporting.
The system prevents processing of Free Goods orders if the healthcare provider has exceeded the annual sample limit or if the material is restricted from promotional sampling.

HP.description: Create Free Goods Sales Order for approved healthcare provider with valid reason code, material not restricted, quantity within annual limit, pricing auto-set to zero

NEG.description: Customer is not approved for promotional samples
Material is restricted from promotional sampling
Customer has exceeded annual sample limit
Attempt to manually override pricing to non-zero value

ERR.description: Missing Reason Code for Free Goods

EDGE.description: Order quantity exactly at annual sample limit (boundary)
Cumulative quantity = 0 (first Free Goods order for this customer)

input.name: orderType
input.label: Order Type
input.validRange: Specific order type code for Free Goods (e.g., ZFGS, ZSAM)

input.name: customerId
input.label: Sold-to Party
input.validRange: Existing healthcare provider customer with eligibility flag

input.name: materialId
input.label: Material
input.validRange: Existing material not restricted from sampling

input.name: quantity
input.label: Order Quantity
input.validRange: Positive integer, must not exceed annual sample limit for customer

input.name: reasonCode
input.label: Free Goods Reason / Reason for Sample
input.validRange: Valid reason code from configured value list (e.g., "New Product Launch", "Physician Sample", "Patient Assistance")

input.name: requestedDeliveryDate
input.label: Requested Delivery Date
input.validRange: Future date, must align with delivery scheduling

autoPopulated.name: salesOrganization
autoPopulated.label: Sales Organization
autoPopulated.trigger: User defaults or order type config

autoPopulated.name: distributionChannel
autoPopulated.label: Distribution Channel
autoPopulated.trigger: User defaults or order type config

autoPopulated.name: netPrice
autoPopulated.label: Net Value / Item Net Price
autoPopulated.trigger: Material + Order Type confirmation (set to 0.00 by pricing procedure)

output.name: cumulativeFreeGoodsQuantity
output.label: Cumulative Free Goods Quantity
output.format: Numeric (aggregated across all prior Free Goods orders)

boundary.name: quantity
boundary.label: Order Quantity
boundary.upperBoundary: Annual sample limit minus cumulative quantity already shipped

boundary.name: cumulativeQuantity
boundary.label: Cumulative Quantity
boundary.upperBoundary: Annual sample limit (e.g., 10,000 units per year)
